title: Appointment booking returns intermittent 500s
description: The hospital appointment-booking service has been returning HTTP 500 for roughly one request in six since yesterday evening. It is intermittent: the same user retrying the same booking usually succeeds within two or three attempts. No single reproduction step has been found. The evidence available is thinner than we would like.
deploy_notes:
Config change 2026-03-11 at 17:40: enabled FEATURE_SLOT_CACHE=true and pointed REDIS_URL at the new managed Redis cluster (redis-prod-2). Applied via the config service. The change was applied to the running deployment; pods were not restarted.
No application code change. Last code deploy was 2026-03-04.
